What we build

Websites and web applications built around your goals

Whether you need a credible online presence or a web application your team uses every day, we start with what the site needs to achieve for your business.

Corporate websites

Clear, professional websites that present your company, services and team with the credibility clients and partners expect.

Business websites

Websites for SMEs that explain your offer, show your work and make it easy for customers to call, message or request a quote.

E-commerce

Online stores that let customers browse products, place orders and pay, with an admin area your team can manage.

Web applications

Browser-based tools such as portals, booking systems and dashboards that replace manual work with a structured workflow.

SEO-friendly builds

Clean structure, fast pages, proper metadata and sitemaps, so search engines can understand and index your website.

Redesigns

Rebuilding outdated websites to be faster, mobile-friendly and easier to update, without losing what already works.

Our approach

Web design and development done properly

A website is often the first place a customer meets your business. We focus on clarity, speed and trust: content that answers real questions, layouts that work on every screen and clear next steps for visitors.

When a project needs more than a website — logins, records, approvals or integrations — we extend it into a web application or connect it to custom business software.

Responsive design
Layouts designed for phones first, then tablets, laptops and large screens.
Performance
Lean pages, optimized images and minimal scripts for fast loading on mobile networks.
Search visibility
Semantic HTML, unique page metadata, structured data and clean URLs.
Accessibility
Readable contrast, keyboard navigation and proper labels so more people can use your site.
Security
HTTPS, careful handling of forms and sensible defaults to reduce common risks.
Maintenance
Updates, fixes and improvements after launch, so the website keeps working for you.

Is it the right fit?

When a new website or web app makes sense

Web development is a good investment when your current online presence is holding the business back, or when a manual process could run better in the browser.

  • You do not have a website yet, or it no longer reflects your business
  • Your current site is slow, hard to use on phones or difficult to update
  • Customers struggle to find your services, prices or contact details
  • You want to sell products or take bookings online
  • Your team relies on spreadsheets or messages for a process that could be a web application

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How much does website development cost in Kenya?

Cost depends on scope: the number of pages, features such as e-commerce or user accounts, content needs and integrations. After a short conversation about your goals we provide a clear proposal and quote for your specific project.

What is the difference between a website and a web application?

A website mainly presents information — your company, services and contact details. A web application lets users do things: log in, submit records, manage orders or view reports. Many businesses start with a website and add web application features as they grow.

Will my website work well on mobile phones?

Yes. Every website we build is responsive and designed mobile-first, because many visitors in Kenya browse primarily on their phones.

Can you maintain the website after launch?

Yes. We offer ongoing software maintenance and support, including updates, fixes, security improvements and new features.
